question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Contempt
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3. 'Regard'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Contempt (अवहेलना)** - Disrespect or the feeling that a person or a thing is beneath consideration, worthless, or deserving scorn.

 
 
• **Example: **They regarded his behaviour with contempt.
 
 
 
• **Regard (सम्मान)** - Consideration or attention directed at something or someone.
 
 
• **Example: **She has a high regard for the works of Shakespeare.
 
 
 
• From the above example it is clear that Regard is the antonym of Contempt.

Therefore, the correct answer is- Regard.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mockery (उपहास)** - Teasing and contemptuous language or behaviour directed at a particular person or thing.

 
 
• **Example:** His speech was greeted with shouts of mockery.
 
 
 
• **Deny (इनकार करना) **- State that one refuses to admit the truth or existence of.
 
 
• **Example:** She denied all knowledge of the incident.
 
 
 
• **Immoral (अनैतिक)** - Not conforming to accepted standards of morality.
 
 
• **Example:** Immoral behaviour includes cheating and lying.
